lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Two signatures, then. Sponsor and witness, one under the other, and print underneath in block capitals because the register is read by people who never met you.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Use a name you do not mind keeping. A witness signature is the one mark in this building that cannot be withdrawn, amended or explained afterwards.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You write it. It is the first entry in a register that will still be open, on a table, in a room with four chairs, in 2312 — and it is in your handwriting.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Provenance is the record of who owned a thing, and when, and on whose word. It is the first thing you learn and the last thing anybody checks.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I have just put myself in the chain of the instrument I was auditing.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That was not a small thing to do, and you did it very quickly.
